Heading level is ['n','1'|'2'|'3']. Tables use bi plus fs table (shared UUID rows/cells, id equal to handle, header flags) and fs tableContent (locale cell inline content). Pages forbid inline math. See document_catalog. On sync_required, follow the returned document_read recipe and reread the latest targets before revising the intended edit.

o.description: Typed DCDP operations for advanced batches. For ordinary plain-text paragraph writes, use the focused paragraph tools. A prior document_validate dry run is optional.

operation.description: One compact typed mutation. Preserve the following exact tag, positions, length, and types; the server decoder validates them. Set field: ["fs",fieldTarget,typedValue]. For paragraph text use field content and value ["i",[["t",text]]]. Unset field: ["fu",fieldTarget]. Insert block: ["bi",newBlockHandle,blockKind,parentBlockHandle,afterBlockHandle]; set content with fs in the same batch. Delete block: ["bd",blockHandle]. Move block: ["bm",blockHandle,parentBlockHandle,afterBlockHandle]. Replace block kind: ["bk",blockHandle,newBlockKind]. Insert relation item: ["ri",blockHandle,relationHandle,newItemHandle,itemKind,afterItemHandle]. Delete relation item: ["rd",blockHandle,relationHandle,itemHandle]. Move relation item: ["rm",sourceBlockHandle,sourceRelationHandle,itemHandle,targetBlockHandle,targetRelationHandle,afterItemHandle]. Attach verified File: ["fa",fieldTarget,fileHandle]. Detach File: ["fd",fieldTarget]. Translation lifecycle: ["lc"] creates the requested non-source translation; ["ld"] deletes it. Either must be the only operation in its batch. Use stable handles from document_read and new unique stable handles for inserted blocks/items. Page rich blocks require a rich-text section parent. Heading level uses ["n","1"], ["n","2"], or ["n","3"]. A table needs bi plus fs table (shared rows/cells with UUID id fields equal to their handles and header flags) and fs tableContent (locale rows/cells with inline content) in one batch. Pages forbid inline math. See document_catalog for kinds and field shapes. Use the empty string when no parent, predecessor, relation, or relation item applies.

compactPayload.description: Compact wire payloads use strings, booleans, and nested arrays. Field target: [block,"","",field] for a block field or [block,relation,item,field] for a relation-item field; an optional fifth item is a nested field path of ["f",field] or ["i",stableItemHandle] segments. Typed values: ["t",text], ["b",boolean], ["n",canonical-number-string], ["i",inline-items], ["l",[[optionalStableItemHandle,typedValue],...]], or ["o",[[field,typedValue],...]]. Inline items: ["t",text], [mark,inline-items] where mark is b/em/u/s/code, [colorMark,color,inline-items] where colorMark is fg/bg, ["a",URL,inline-items], ["br"], ["math",expression], or ["ph",placeholderHandle], ["siteVariable",key] or ["siteVariable",key,true]. Site variable keys are site.title, site.url, site.companyName, contact.legalEmail, contact.email. Only site.url/contact.* may be linked. Do not send untagged field scalars, null, objects, or native JSON numbers; numeric values use canonical decimal strings. The server decoder validates all tag-specific slot constraints.

name: file_transfer
title: Transfer a File
description: Begin, inspect, or complete one File ingest through the existing File authority. Field sets per action: begin multipart (t=browser_upload_page|presigned_multipart) takes k,t,n,m,s and optional lm; begin remote_https takes k,t,u and correlation_id; status takes h; complete takes h and optional client_media_bundle_id. Other fields are rejected. Multipart bytes use the existing authenticated browser upload flow. Direct audio/video requires browser-prepared derivatives; complete must pass the client_media_bundle_id returned by status after browser preparation. For a public HTTPS source, remote_https uses the existing server import and processing flow; all kinds except general require a stable correlation_id reused on retry. track_audio requires track_id and attaches through native Track authority/CAS. Omit expected_current_file_id only when the Track has no original audio; otherwise copy its current File UUID. Pass the returned session handle unchanged, including its Track/CAS fields.

a.description: Action. begin starts one File transfer (requires k and t); status inspects and complete finishes a multipart session (both require h). Send only the fields listed for the chosen action/transport.

k.description: begin only, required. File ingest kind. track_audio attaches original audio through existing Track authority and CAS; audio remains an independent editor File.

t.description: begin only, required. browser_upload_page/presigned_multipart: multipart bytes through the existing authenticated browser upload flow (MCP carries metadata only). remote_https: server import from a public HTTPS URL.

n.description: begin multipart: required; forbidden for remote_https. Original filename including its extension.

m.description: begin multipart: required; forbidden for remote_https. Original MIME type; must match the filename and verified bytes.

s.description: begin multipart: required; forbidden for remote_https. Original File size in bytes.

lm.description: begin multipart: optional; forbidden for remote_https. Original last-modified time in Unix epoch milliseconds, used for upload resumption.

u.description: begin remote_https: required; forbidden for multipart. Public HTTPS source URL without credentials or a fragment. Server import verifies bytes and uses existing media processing.

track_id.description: begin: required when k is track_audio, forbidden otherwise. Existing Track UUID.

expected_current_file_id.description: begin, k=track_audio only: Track audio replacement CAS; copy the current original audio File UUID. Omit only when no original audio is attached. Forbidden for other kinds.

correlation_id.description: begin remote_https only: stable UUID for one durable remote import; required for every kind except general. Reuse the same UUID on retry; use a new UUID for a different source import. Forbidden for multipart.

h.description: status/complete: required; forbidden for begin. Session handle returned by begin or status; pass it unchanged.

track_ids.description: Every Track ID in exactly one Release, in desired order. The owning service validates complete Release membership.

name: track_settings_update
title: Update Track settings
description: Update supplied Track settings through the owning Release service. Use track_reorder for a complete Release ordering. An empty title leaves the existing title unchanged.

clear_duration.description: When true, removes duration even if duration_seconds is supplied.

clear_audio_original.description: Remove the audio original association; downloads are disabled by the owning service.

clear_lyrics.description: When true, removes lyrics even if lyrics is supplied.
